observations: A pair of rectangular eyeglass frames drawn in white and black lines sits horizontally across the middle of the image, forming the clearest geometric anchor in an otherwise dense tangle of marks.
The mouth area is built from overlapping red, black, and yellow lines that splay outward toward the lower center, with a row of white lines suggesting teeth against a darker interior gap.

Loose black scribble loops extend beyond the face edges at upper right and lower left, while a purple-grey field occupies the left background and yellow dominates the right, creating an uneven color split behind the figure.
reading: The eyeglass frames are the one steady horizontal in an otherwise restless surface—everything above and below them breaks into competing marks. Red and yellow lines push forward while the purple-grey background recedes, giving the face a forward-leaning feeling. The tooth row and dark interior gap at the mouth read as loud or urgent. Scribble loops that escape the face boundary suggest the energy here is not fully contained.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors 'nnxyz nifty faces #1' and 'nnxyz nifty faces #3'; title order and recorded creation order align for these three. The collector links the layered line patterns here to the scrimshaw interest noted across the collection.

connections.reason: Both works center a face with a visible tooth row and dark interior gap at the mouth, but #1 uses a cool green-dominant palette with teal eye details, while #2 shifts to warm yellow-red and adds the horizontal specificity of eyeglass frames.

In #3 a single eye is ringed by tight concentric lines that create a focal point of stillness; in #2 the eyeglass frames perform a similar anchoring role but through a horizontal geometric shape rather than a spiral.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly do the eyeglass frames begin and end, and what lines beneath them are doing the work of describing the nose and cheeks?
ambiguities: The dense mark layering makes it unclear whether some colored areas are filled shapes or accumulated overlapping strokes.
